I am an old woman, seventy years now, and I have farmed these lands my whole life here in Mbeya. On this small plot I plant my beans together with maize as I have always done — the beans help the soil, everyone knows this, so I do not buy the fertilizer from the shop for them. I have no money for chemicals and no schooling to read the packets, so I save seeds from last harvest like my mother taught me. My back is tired but my daughter-in-law helps me weed, and sometimes I pay a young man from the village a few days to help dig when the rains come.
